title: Illustrative maximum bearer replay window
method: Synthetic token lifetimes. Assumes theft immediately after issuance and validation by signature/expiry only, without revocation or sender constraints; ignores clock tolerance. Not breach probability or a recommended universal lifetime.
alt: Illustrative maximum bearer replay window. Illustrative values: 5 minute token 5 minutes, 15 minute token 15 minutes, 60 minute token 60 minutes.
